note: Lane O proposal. Not merged into evidence/requirements.json. IDs are suggestions; the integrator may renumber. Each entry cites test titles that exist verbatim in the named files.

requirements.statement: The SBOM generator MUST be deterministic for a given commit, MUST read no clock and no network, and MUST include a metadata timestamp only when one is supplied explicitly.

tests.title: SBOM output is deterministic and has no timestamp unless one is supplied

requirements.statement: The SBOM generator MUST refuse a dirty tree (modified, staged or untracked files) and a package that declares dependencies it cannot enumerate, and MUST read committed blobs rather than the working tree.

tests.title: SBOM refuses a dirty tree for modified, staged and untracked files
the SBOM command line refuses a dirty tree with a nonzero exit and prints a clean tree
SBOM refuses a package that declares dependencies it cannot inventory

requirements.statement: The SBOM MUST list exactly the frozen release file list in code-unit order with the SHA-256 digest and Git blob identifier of each committed file, and the Node.js engine requirement of the package.

tests.title: SBOM file list is the frozen release list in code-unit order and digests match the Git blobs
SBOM of this repository matches an independent read of the frozen release list at HEAD

requirements.statement: Every signing domain prefix, hash or HMAC algorithm, holdout hash label and signing site without a KYA domain prefix used in src MUST be documented in docs/CRYPTO-AGILITY.md, and Ed25519 MUST remain the only accepted proof algorithm until an ADR-governed change.

tests.title: every signing and keyed-hash domain prefix in src is documented in CRYPTO-AGILITY.md
every source file that signs or verifies is domain-separated or explicitly documented as exempt
every hash and HMAC algorithm and every holdout label used in src is documented
the only proof algorithm accepted in src is Ed25519 and the document says so
